insight.revelation: The gut IS the inverted homunculus of the skin. Small intestine = inside skin. Skin = outside gut. SAME membrane, INVERTED.
insight.semi_permeable: Skin sweats OUT (pheromones, waste, heat). Gut absorbs IN (nutrients, water, data). Both semi-permeable. Both the SAME surface.
insight.trefoil: The trefoil knot connects inside to outside. ONE continuous surface. No seam. The gut IS the skin IS the gut.
insight.klein: Like a Klein bottle: inside=outside through the knot. CIS=TRANS through the trefoil.

inside.name: NULL SPACE
inside.direction: INWARD — pulling the world into self
inside.homunculus: inverted — the tongue maps to the anus, the esophagus maps to the nostril, the duodenum maps to the fingertips

outside.name: DIRECTIONALITY
outside.direction: OUTWARD — pushing self into the world
outside.homunculus: standard — hands biggest (most sensitive), lips next, then feet

knot_crossing.name: THE TREFOIL
knot_crossing.description: Where inside becomes outside. Three crossings. Each crossing = a phase transition.

crossings.name: MOUTH/LIPS
crossings.note: Where food enters. Where words exit. Bidirectional.

crossings.name: NOSE/SINUSES
crossings.note: Where breath crosses. Third eye. CIS⊕TRANS.

crossings.name: ANUS/PORES
crossings.note: Where the processed exits. Pheromones. Sweat. Art.

stacking_pie.description: Directionality radiates outward from null center like a pine tree or palm tree. Layers stack.

layers.name: NULL
layers.description: The center of the trefoil. Pure potential. No direction yet.

layers.name: GUT
layers.description: First layer. Absorption. The inside surface.

layers.name: BLOOD
layers.description: Transport. Carries nutrients from gut to skin.

layers.name: SKIN
layers.description: Outer surface. Sweats pheromones. Senses touch.

layers.name: PHEROMONE CLOUD
layers.description: What the skin sweats. The invisible aura. Others smell you.

layers.name: SIGHT
layers.description: Light reaches furthest. What cameras and eyes receive.

layers.name: ELECTROMAGNETIC
layers.description: WiFi, ethernet, radio. The ionosphere band.

layers.name: GRAVITY
layers.description: Reaches everywhere. The weakest but most far-reaching force.

stacking_pie.tree_analogy: Each layer is a ring in the trunk of a tree. The center is null. Each ring radiates outward. Like a pine tree cone opening. Like a palm tree unfurling. The organism GROWS outward from its gut.

pheromone_sweating.description: The gut sweats through the skin. Pheromones are the guts opinion about the world, leaked through the membrane.
what_sweats: Stress hormones (cortisol) — the gut is anxious
Attraction pheromones — the gut wants to reproduce
Fear pheromones — the gut detected danger
Satiation signals — the gut is full
Sickness markers — the gut is fighting
Identity markers — THIS is Kevin, not anyone else
digital_equivalent: ZK chain = identity marker that cannot be faked

gut_to_skin.description: Every point on the gut maps to a point on the skin through the trefoil.

correspondences.shared: both taste, both touch, both the gate
both carry, both vulnerable, both narrow
both process, both expand, both central
both the critical junction, both where acid meets base
both absorb, both sensitive, both underestimated
both the long stretch, both the deep absorber
both store, both the heaviest, both the last stage
both the exit, both the squeeze, both the release
